fixes: Line 1: open on the ignition. Use [1805.5-1808.4 crop 0.5] (engines light at 1806, capsule leaves the pad in a fireball), then [1823.9-1825.9 crop 0.5] (capsule streaking with flame). Drop 1830-1836.3: 1826-1831 and 1834-1836 are empty sky.
Line 2: use the calm pad shots only, e.g. [1795.0-1797.6 crop 0.5] and [1800.5-1803.2 crop 0.55]; remove 1806.2-1808.35 since it moves to line 1.

Lines 3 and 4: replace the four-panel monitor feed (1808.5 to 1823.8) with single-camera footage: [1831.8-1834.4 crop 0.5] (capsule pitching with flame) and the tracking shot [1837.0-1840.0 fit]. If there is not enough clean footage, shorten line 3 to one clause so it fits fewer shots.

Keep lines 6 to 8 as they are; heat shield drop, airbags and the landing on the desert floor read well. Loop: the last landing shot cuts back to the ignition fireball, which works.
